title: Machine learning-based models to predict 90-day non-excellent functional outcomes among patients with mild acute ischemic stroke after intravenous thrombolysis.
summary: Machine-learning models predicted 90-day functional outcomes after thrombolysis in mild acute ischemic stroke, with validation-cohort assessment. The result is reported in the Frontiers in Neurology. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
